## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: `ticket show <id> --include-scratch` adds a `scratch` object to JSON output

## Description

Modify plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-show.sh to accept `--include-scratch`. When set, walk the per-ticket scratch directory and merge each `<key>` envelope into a top-level `scratch` object on the JSON output: `scratch: { "<key>": { ts, value }, ... }`. When the directory does not exist or is empty, emit `scratch: {}` (empty object, not absent). When the flag is omitted, the output is unchanged from current behavior (no `scratch` key present).

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)

Given a ticket with two scratch envelopes (k1, k2); When `dso ticket show <id> --include-scratch` runs; Then stdout JSON contains `scratch.k1.value` and `scratch.k2.value`. Given the same ticket without `--include-scratch`; When `dso ticket show <id>` runs; Then the output JSON does NOT contain a `scratch` key. Given a ticket with no scratch directory; When `dso ticket show <id> --include-scratch` runs; Then output contains `scratch: {}` (empty object).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] --include-scratch merges scratch envelopes into JSON output under `scratch` key
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-show-include.sh
- [ ] Default output (no flag) omits `scratch` key entirely (backward compatible)
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-show-include.sh
- [ ] Empty scratch directory produces `scratch: {}` not absent
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-show-include.sh
- [ ] New test is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scratch/test-scratch-show-include.sh

## File Impact

| Path | Action |
|------|--------|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-show.sh | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-show-include.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
